source: Water as a compound of the PR78 cubic (batch 2026-11-11-aqueous-solvents, plan M2): IAPWS-95 critical point (Tc 647.096 K, Pc 22.064 MPa), acentric factor 0.3443, normal boiling point 373.124 K, standard liquid density 999.0 kg/m3 at 60 F (IAPWS-95, rounded); Mathias-Copeman alpha c1 0.91976, c2 -0.33844, c3 0.33431 matched to the Wagner-Pruss saturation line from 0 to 370 C (tools/aqueous-solvents/cubic-water.mjs). Molar mass 0.01801528 kg/mol and the vapour Shomate Cp of the water model icheme:water (water-iapws95-shomate-r3), fitted by least squares as shifted_polynomial_5 over 273.16..900 K (27 points), largest deviation 0.016 % at 307.8 K. Imported by tools/compound-import (cubic_water).

fluid_domain.evidence: Fluid network only: the water model Cp fit range, from its triple point.

freezing.source: The anchor of icheme:crystal_ice_ih (revision crystal-ice-ih-r1), its values and estimated flag. Water melts at 273.1525 K at 1 atm, 0.0075 K below its triple point: normal_melting_kelvin holds the triple point, as the anchor does. Data only: never a validity floor or a range end.
